notes.title: Henry's journey continues! Episode 2 is coming in 2025!
notes.content: [p][b]The next Episode is coming soon! We are well underway with the 2nd Episode of The Guardian of Nature![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to all your wonderful feedback on Episode 1, our small team has been busy like bees 🐝, working hard on the next Episode — which will be ready for you by[b] the end of 2025![/b][/p][p][/p][p]We are continuing with Early Access to collect feedback until the final release. [b]We are releasing the game in three Episodes[/b] — we think of it a bit like a limited series — to tell Henry’s magical story.[/p][p][/p][p][u][b]Where we are and what’s next for Episode 2 and 3:[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]We will release Episode 2 by the end of 2025. Episode 3 will follow in 2026.[/p][/*][*][p]Episode 2 picks up right where Episode 1 ended.[/p][/*][*][p]You’ll be able explore a new area of the island, visit new environments, solve new puzzles and uncover more of Henry’s journey.[/p][/*][*][p][b]If you’ve already purchased Episode 1, you’ll receive Episode 2 and 3 for free.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]The price of the game will increase slightly with each Episode – so early birds will catch the very best deal! 🐦💚[/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]If you have any questions about the episodic release, feel free to reach out![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for your amazing support![/p][p]Take good care 🌿[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209094/80cb335e1a987b00706100c522bde2a9726256f7.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Thank You for a Wonderful Launch!
notes.content: [p][b]Wow – what an incredible first week![/b] We’re so grateful for all your kind words, support, and thoughtful reviews. Seeing The Guardian of Nature resonate with so many of you really means the world to us as a small indie team.[/p][p][/p][p][b]If you enjoyed the 1st Episode and the start of Henry’s adventure, leaving a short review on Steam would help us a lot[/b] 💚.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s next?[/b][/p][p]We are already deep into the development of Episode 2! The story continues as Henry journeys towards the Tree of Life – but will he succeed in restoring the balance of nature? Here are some sketches and a final environment. We can already tell you this much: There will be ants involved ☺️🐜🐜🐜.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209094/ca4cd304f6e201a72e72872041690e14429317cc.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209094/fd501f631b437b18140711f54be587bbfea40e01.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209094/8c7d423af9254e45994d2854d889e88ad0bad6b5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Episode 2 will feature roughly the same number of environments, puzzles and playtime as the 1st Episode. We can't wait to share more details soon![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for your amazing support! [/p][p]Take good care 🌿[/p]

notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="qvvnrG5QMc4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Hey Guardians! 🌸[/p][p][/p][p][b]We're thrilled to announce that Episode 1 of «The Guardian of Nature» just had its surprise release as part of Wholesome Direct 2025![/b] [/p][p][/p][p]We are beyond excited to finally share the first episode with all of you![/p][p]Thank you all so much for your support and feedback, and for encouraging us on our journey! 💚[/p][p]We're releasing episodically during Early Access because we would love to hear your feedback along the way! notes.title: Major Demo Update & Kickstarter Launching Soon! (Please spread the word 🙏)
notes.content:
Hey Guardians! 🌸

While this update has been a long time coming, we have been busy like bees! 😇🐝 [b]We have some exciting news to share with you![/b]

[b]First of all: Thank you so much for all of your incredibly helpful feedback when playing the «The Guardian of Nature» demo [/b]🙏. We are so grateful that thousands of people have played the demo and that so many of you took the time to write down your thoughts, your play experience, what you liked and how we could improve the game. And we did! Many of you told us that there were these key things that you would like to see in the game:

✅[b] ✨ More story and background[/b] about The Guardians of Nature and the mission of Henry.
✅ [b]🧩 Hint system for puzzles[/b].
✅ 🗺️ An[b] in-game navigation[/b] to explore and visit all the environments.
✅ [b]🎛️ Quality of life improvements [/b]like more settings for sound and music.
✅[b] 🌸 More music tracks[/b] to change between environments.

[b]Introducing: The Book of Nature! 📔
[/b]
Many of the above points have been addressed by the creation of The Book of Nature, which tells the story of «The Guardian of Nature» through a beautiful fairytale-inspired narrative. Throughout the game, you will [b]regularly find and collect "Nature Cards"[/b], which unlock new pages in the book 📔. They tell you more about the ancient wisdom of the Guardians of Nature, the interconnectedness of nature, and give you hints on how to continue your journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209094/c6ffcdd27045edb92c9b01799b647c027dd71a5b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209094/adce3017204146c9f1183baf395072b3bbd52be8.png[/img]

Once you have accessed locations, they become accessible in The Book of Nature 📔. [b]A map helps you to navigate and understand how environments are connected 🗺️.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209094/10d3cb40c11d1df9f5011353c7f2cdb57567161b.png[/img]

In addition: We will be releasing a new and updated demo of the game very soon, alongside a [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/inlusio/the-guardian-of-nature-game]Kickstarter campaign[/url] that we are currently preparing. [/b]

[b]It would mean the world to us if you would follow the Kickstarter campaign[/b] to be notified when it launches and tell your friends about it. Have a look here:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/inlusio/the-guardian-of-nature-game/


While early funding and our own resources will allow us to bring «The Guardian of Nature» to market, this Kickstarter campaign will allow us to realise the full vision of the game and share an exciting moment in the game’s journey together with you as a community!

Thank you for everything and take good care  🌱
Your fellow Guardians

notes.title: Book of Nature #01: When Henry meets Froggy
notes.content:
Hey Guardians!

A lot has happened since our last update and dev stream at the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2421950/view/6622046884293960335]Storyteller’s Festival[/url]. We have been slow on updates and we want to change that! 

We are hard at work and we want to give you some regular updates on what we are working on and give you a glimpse into our design process. Because everything in «The Guardian of Nature» is made by hand!

In this first entry of our Dev Diary, we’ll be sharing some exciting behind-the-scenes details. We want to make every aspect of our game to be magical, from the lush environments to the intricate character designs.

Today, we want to show you how we created a scene where Henry, who can, yes, change in size, meets a frog. See how we started with simple sketches, refined the scene and finally added lighting and colour grading.

Stay tuned for more updates, sneak peeks, and insights into our development journey. We can't wait to share more with you!

We’re looking forward to hearing your feedback! Until next time and happy exploring :)

-The Guardian of Nature Team

notes.title: We are streaming «The Guardian of Nature» at The Storyteller's Festival!
notes.content:
We are super excited to stream our exploration adventure and puzzle game «The Guardian of Nature» for the very first time during The Storyteller's Festival!

We can't wait to show you what the game is all about! In short, «The Guardian of Nature» tells the magical journey of Henry, a botanist who uses his ability to change in size to save the world he is living in. The Tree of Life and its crucial mycelium network which connect the whole forest are in danger. It’s a perspective-changing story of epic proportions. Players explore the beauty of nature in big and small, solve solarpunk puzzles and dive into the magical world of mycelium to eventually put nature back in order.
